label: Blob (amorphous)
comment: The amorphous archetype -- slime, ooze, elemental, cloud. Named for the shape and not for the genre skin, the way bird and serpent are: 'slime' names one costume and 'amorphous' names the category rather than the skeleton. Same normalized frame as every other template, Blender axes: +X is the subject's left, -Y is forward, +Z is up. A blob has no limbs, so what it needs a skeleton for is a *centre of mass that can rise and sink* and a *surface that can bulge*: base/core/crown/top are that vertical column, and the four lobes are the equator. A pose carries rotation only, so squash and stretch are authored as the lobes swinging down-and-out or up-and-in about the equator while root_translation drops or lifts the whole body -- see templates/clips/blob.json.
